pages.heading: Operations Committee
lines: The Operations Committee reviewed the dock electrification proposal.
The Operations Committee recommended a two-phase rollout to the Board.
The committee requested an updated outage plan from the operations director.

pages.heading: Board resolutions
lines: The Board approved phase one of the dock electrification project.
The Board authorized $4.2 million for phase one of dock electrification.
The Board deferred phase two of dock electrification until the July review.

pages.heading: Follow-up actions
lines: The operations director will deliver the updated outage plan by 18 June.
The finance director will report on phase-one spending in July.
The Board moved the next regular meeting to 24 July.

pages.heading: Capital Planning Committee
lines: The Capital Planning Committee recommended replacing depot heating units.
The Capital Planning Committee reviewed two equipment bids.
The committee asked management to collect monthly energy figures.

pages.heading: Audit Committee
lines: The Audit Committee approved the 2027 internal audit plan.
The Audit Committee appointed Lena Park as engagement lead.
The first audit review is scheduled for September.

pages.heading: Board decision
lines: The Board approved the replacement of depot heating units.
The Board set a spending cap of $760,000 for depot heating units.
The Board asked the finance team to report actual spending each quarter.

maple-energy.title: Maple Energy | Board and Committee Record

pages.heading: Sustainability Committee
lines: The Sustainability Committee reviewed the methane monitoring pilot.
The Sustainability Committee recommended a pilot at three facilities.
The committee requested a baseline emissions report.

pages.heading: Risk Committee
lines: The Risk Committee approved the revised incident escalation policy.
The Risk Committee set the escalation threshold at 30 minutes.
The next policy review is scheduled for December.

pages.heading: Board resolutions
lines: The Board approved a methane monitoring pilot at two facilities.
The Board allocated $285,000 to the methane monitoring pilot.
The Board assigned the pilot to Chief Operating Officer Mara Sen.
